data.one_liner: Test support for package:source_gen with helpers to validate success and failure cases.
data.what_it_does: Provides test helpers like annotations (`@ShouldGenerate`, `@ShouldThrow`, `@ShouldGenerateFile`) and batch verification utilities to validate `source_gen` generators by annotating test files.
use_when: You are writing a custom source_gen Generator or GeneratorForAnnotation and need to test success and failure outputs
You want to test code generation against golden output files
You need combinatorial batch verification of AST and declaration permutations for generators
avoid_when: You are not writing custom code generation tools
Your project does not use source_gen
strengths: Simplifies testing of source_gen generators via annotations
Supports golden file testing for generated output
Includes combinatorial batch verification for stress-testing generators
weaknesses: Limited usefulness outside of developing custom code generators
data.setup_notes: Add source_gen_test to dev_dependencies and use annotations on test classes.
